articles.title: IMF backs gradual BOJ rate hikes as Iran war and weak Yen fuel inflation risks
articles.mainIdea: IMF backs gradual BOJ rate hikes as Iran war and weak Yen fuel inflation risks
articles.summary: Investing.com: IMF backs gradual BOJ rate hikes as Iran war and weak Yen fuel inflation risks. Investing.com -- The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has signaled its support for the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to maintain its current trajectory of interest rate hikes, despite "significant new risks" emerging from the conflict in the Middle East. articles.title: Toyota Financial Services Announces Leadership Transition
articles.mainIdea: Toyota Financial Services Announces Leadership Transition
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Toyota Financial Services Announces Leadership Transition. Toyota Financial Services (TFS) today announced that Scott Cooke, president and chief executive officer, will retire effective June 30, 2026, after more than two decades of distinguished service with the company. Alec Hagey, TFS executive advisor, has been named successor and will assume the role of president and CEO, effective April 6, 2026.
